name: ctpop-islet-parameterization
description: Bind documented HRA-aligned islet beta-cell-composition fractions to the Topp2000 beta-cell-mass model's (BIOMD0000000341) initial beta-cell mass, and run healthy vs beta-depleted composition scenarios to show the resulting glucose-regulation consequence.

model_id.description: BioModels identifier of the Topp2000 beta-cell-mass model.

t_end.description: Simulated horizon in the model's own time units. The Topp model operates on a DAYS timescale (beta-cell-mass turnover); a multi-thousand-unit horizon is needed for B and G to visibly move.

n_points.description: Number of output time points per scenario.

ctpop_islet_step.doc: Bind documented HRA-aligned islet beta-cell fractions to the Topp2000 beta-cell-mass model's (BIOMD0000000341) initial beta-cell mass, and run healthy vs beta-depleted composition scenarios to show the glucose-regulation consequence.

_contract.summary: Bind documented HRA-aligned islet beta-cell fractions to the Topp2000 beta-cell-mass model's (BIOMD0000000341) initial beta-cell mass, and run healthy vs beta-depleted composition scenarios to show the glucose-regulation consequence.

outputs.runs: Per-scenario Topp2000 trajectory (`healthy`/`beta_depleted` by default): `time`/`B`/`G`/`I` arrays plus `beta_fraction`/`b_init`/`b_ref`/`model_id`. Empty dict per scenario on any fetch/solve failure (network, missing deps, SBML parse, solver).
outputs.islet_composition: Echo of `ISLET_COMPOSITION`: documented HRA-aligned islet beta/alpha/delta/PP-epsilon fractions, each with its Cell-Ontology id and literature citation.
outputs.reference_beta_fraction: The healthy reference beta-cell fraction (0.54) the binding scales against.

assumptions: ISLET_COMPOSITION is documented literature/HRA-ASCT+B composition, not a live HRA CTpop API pull -- a live CTpop query for a specific RUI-registered tissue block would give a different, block-specific composition.
Binding is initial-mass only: the beta fraction rescales the Topp model's initial beta-cell mass B; alpha/delta fractions are not (yet) bound to any Topp model parameter.

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
